description: The Principal will see you now. Step into this scene in WEAPONS where Academy Award® nominee Amy Madigan brings restraint, intelligence, and emotional precision to her portrayal of "Aunt Gladys". Madigan navigates the scene’s tightly constructed dialogue and deliberate pacing, reflecting a screenplay grounded in character-driven storytelling and enduring dramatic resonance.
title: From Script to Screen - Principal's Office with Aunt Gladys (Amy Madigan) | WEAPONS #shorts
